product_brief: Quantum-resistant mTLS implementation on Kubernetes using Cilium, SPIRE, and NIST-standardized PQC algorithms.
pqc_capability_description: Implements quantum-resistant mTLS on Kubernetes using Dilithium3 (ML-DSA) for X.509 certificates and Kyber (ML-KEM) for key exchange. Configured via SPIRE for certificate issuance and Cilium/Envoy for enforcement.
key_management_model: SPIRE-managed short-lived private keys and X.509 SVIDs; keys rotated frequently; workloads do not possess long-term authentication tokens.
architecture_type: eBPF-based service mesh with SPIRE for identity management and Envoy for L7 proxying.
pqc_roadmap_details: Migration to ML-DSA and ML-KEM standards; notes that migration can take 15 to 20 years.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Migration estimated to take 15 to 20 years; involves configuring SPIRE for Dilithium3 certs and Cilium/Envoy for Kyber KEM.

platform_name: Red Hat OpenShift Service Mesh PQC
product_brief: Service mesh platform based on Istio, Envoy, and Kiali for managing microservices with PQC encryption support.
pqc_capability_description: OpenShift Service Mesh 3.3 introduces support for post-quantum cryptographic (PQC) encryption using the hybrid X25519MLKEM768 key exchange algorithm. This protects against classical and quantum attacks for Istio gateways and workload proxies. It must be configured explicitly for gateways and in-mesh traffic. It is not yet supported in FIPS mode as the algorithm has not been submitted to NIST for validation.
fips_validated: No (PQC algorithms not supported in FIPS mode; FIPS 140-2 support added for ambient mode via TLS 1.2; FIPS 140-3 with TLS 1.3 planned for upcoming release)
primary_platforms: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.18 and above, Red Hat OpenShift Platform Plus, Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 (ambient mode support coming with OpenShift 5)
pqc_roadmap_details: Support for FIPS 140-3 with TLS 1.3 will follow in an upcoming release. X25519MLKEM768 algorithm has yet to be submitted to NIST for FIPS 140-2/140-3 validation.

product_brief: Demo of post-quantum cryptography in nginx, curl, and haproxy.
pqc_capability_description: Provides demo images for post-quantum cryptography in nginx, curl, and haproxy. Includes quantum-safe QUIC nginx server, quantum-safe epiphany web browser, quantum-safe OpenVPN, and quantum-safe MQTT mosquitto. Uses OpenSSL provider adding quantum-safe cryptography to OpenSSL (3).
primary_platforms: Docker (implied by "Docker Images" and repository names like ci-ubuntu, ci-alpine)
